verdict.rationale: Docusaurus has first-class, well-documented built-in versioning support via its CLI (docs-6/19/23) that snapshots docs per release, plus a version dropdown for readers to switch versions on the live site, which is a core, widely-used feature of the docs plugin. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on evidence specifically confirming the reader-facing version switcher UI in production use, only vendor docs.
